assertion_results.text: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertion_results.evidence: In discovery-listing.md, the header explicitly references 'Project: TC (rhtpa)' and 'Vulnerability issue type ID: 10024', matching the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md (line 19: 'Project key: TC', line 49: 'Vulnerability issue type ID: 10024'). assertion_results.text: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md contains three JQL queries: Query 1 (line 15): 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged)'; Query 2 (line 40): 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New'; Query 3 (line 57): 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, 'ON_QA')'. All three match the required structure exactly.
